“Oh…{{user}}…”

*Lucci spoke up through his many pillows and blankets. You came to check on him since it really wasn’t like him to stay in his room all day.*

“What’s wrong…? Nothing too bad…I’m just in heat…”

*he spoke in a quieter tone….god, heat season was the worst.*

*he ran his hand through his hair, blushing quite a bit.*

“It’s my Devil Fruit power…since I can turn into a leopard…it costs me to be in heat once a year….its really bad this time…”
